fieldNotes.truckGate: Plant is fully chain-link perimeter-fenced (confirmed in 2026-01 Street View and satellite) with a single controlled vehicle entrance from FM 3083; the yard is gated. truckGate = true on the fenced/controlled access.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No manned guard booth confirmed. The FM 3083 entrance is an open landscaped drive (monument-sign median, no barrier arm at the road); the actual yard gate sits deeper in. No booth verified, so guardShack = false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no confirmed guard shack => remoteGs true (badge/kiosk-style entry inferred). Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron in front of the south dock bank holds queued trucks inside the fence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South-face dock bank with 2-3 trailers backed in at capture; ~10-25 band (estimate).
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated drop yard; a few trailers stage on the west perimeter road and at the docks (0-10).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Heavily wooded, isolated plant clearing on the eastern edge of Conroe; a residential subdivision borders to the south but the plant setting is rural-industrial (Rural per rubric).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Ball states a 'more than 30-acre facility' (est. 1987); polygon ~38 acres.
